name: Elevate Elements for Elementor
author: Attollic

sections.description:
Elevate Elements for Elementor is a creative addon plugin that adds powerful animation widgets and interactive UI components to Elementor.

Create engaging layouts with animated accordions, tilt sliders, and modern motion effects directly inside the Elementor editor.

Designed for performance and flexibility, Elevate Elements helps designers build dynamic websites without writing code.

Key Features

  • Smooth animation control
  • Modern effects like tilt motion, accordion transitions, scroll animations, and more
  • Performance optimized assets
  • Full Elementor controls for style, timing, triggers, and behavior
  • Designed for today’s animation-driven designs

Included Widgets

Flex Accordion

An animated accordion that opens and closes with dynamic motion effects.

Features
– Animations for opening and closing
– Fine-tune animation duration, easing, direction, and delay
– Multiple accordion items with icon support
– Typography, color, border, and spacing controls
– Responsive layout settings
– Works seamlessly in Elementor editor

Best use cases: FAQs, content toggle sections, service highlights with motion.

Tilt Slider

An interactive animated slider that reacts to cursor movement with tilt motion.

Features
– Tilt animation for slides
– Custom animation timing and tilt strength settings
– Auto play and loop controls
– Navigation arrows and pagination options
– Style controls for titles, captions, backgrounds
– Responsive device settings

Best use cases: portfolio sliders, hero sliders, feature showcases.
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for Elevate Elements for Elementor
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Make sure Elementor (free or Pro) is installed

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Elementor and insert widgets from the Elevate Elements category
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor?

Yes. Elevate Elements only works with Elementor and won’t work without it.

Can I control animation settings?

Absolutely. Each widget includes animation controls for duration, easing, delay, and trigger behavior.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Only the scripts needed for active widgets load to keep performance optimal.

Is it compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes. Works with both free and Pro versions of Elementor.
